title: Scene list
description: Timeline document consumed by the Remotion compositions. All times are in SECONDS (not frames). Scene 1 must start at 0 and every scene must begin exactly where the previous one ends, so the sequence has no gaps or overlaps.

id.description: Stable, unique scene number. Also used as the scene's NAME.

end.description: End time in seconds, exclusive. Must be greater than start.

duration.description: Length in seconds. Must equal end - start; src/scenes.ts rejects the file when it does not.

footage_query.description: Search term used to find the footage on NASA / Wikimedia Commons / Internet Archive.

source_preference.description: Preferred archive. A fallback source is allowed at fetch time.

animation_type.description: Which Remotion component renders this scene.

text_overlay.description: On-screen text. null means the scene shows no text.

sfx_cue.description: Sound-effect cue name resolved against the audio library. null means silent.
